# ThisIsTheWay.to

> Best practice guides for building a career in software development.

ThisIsTheWay.to is a collection of opinionated guides on various software and career development topics.

## Guides

- [Build with AI Agents](https://thisistheway.to/ai/llms.txt): Turning agent misses into systemic improvements
- [Build a Continuous Software Engine](https://thisistheway.to/engine): Conceptual guide to building a deterministic engine around coding agents
- [Engine guide text](https://thisistheway.to/engine/llms.txt): Machine-readable overview and chapter links
- [1. State & Contracts Outside the Context Window](https://thisistheway.to/engine/state-and-contracts): Content-hashed goal files, isolated worktrees, commit trailers, evidence directories, and local transactional ledgers
- [2. Independent Verification & Transactional Landing](https://thisistheway.to/engine/verification-and-landing): Deterministic gates, fresh-context independent review, rebase-then-verify landing, and culprit-only rollback
- [3. Never Getting Stuck: Watchdogs, Recovery & Liveness](https://thisistheway.to/engine/liveness-and-recovery): Process-group watchdogs, livelock detection, network parking, strategy rotation, oscillation guards, and exhaustive finite-state liveness
- [4. Ambition, Self-Improvement & Human Steering](https://thisistheway.to/engine/ambition-and-steering): Non-blocking human approval parking, ambition document with read-only planner, cross-task self-improvement, and metric-gated experiments
- [5. Multiplayer & Multi-Machine Coordination](https://thisistheway.to/engine/multiplayer-coordination): Issue-to-PR goal intake, bidirectional remote sync, atomic remote Git ref leases, and landing-time trailer deduplication
